purpose: Navigation and comparison for nine selected platform cases. Evidence summaries retain military, development and civilian-comparator distinctions; this is not an inventory or a common maturity ranking. Dossier paths are relative to this index and contain the source ledgers.

cases.nameZh: 五八智能四足平台（机器狼配套）
cases.nameEn: Five Eight quadruped platform for the robot-wolf system
cases.role: Company-attributed platform contribution to a military system; Q20A identified for the 2024 exhibition, 2025 configuration unresolved.
cases.strongestEvidence: Official 2025 parade appearance and aggregate in-service statement; Five Eight separately claims its platform contribution.
cases.autonomyEvidence: A 2024 signed assessment says complex activity requires human operation; no configuration-specific operating test reviewed.
cases.unresolved: Contracting chain, 2025 platform configuration, supplied subsystems and current human intervention requirements.

cases.role: Military unmanned aircraft with reported PLA training and in-service status.
cases.strongestEvidence: PLA Daily reported realistic training in November 2021 and explicitly described WZ-7 as in-service in November 2022.
cases.autonomyEvidence: Reported ordered takeoff and information transmission to a command post; allocation of flight decisions is unspecified.
cases.unresolved: Exact legal OEM, model-specific acceptance, operating availability and division of responsibility between people and software.

cases.role: Military unmanned aircraft with PLA unit activity and an external observation.
cases.strongestEvidence: PLA-operated flying display and maintenance reported in November 2022; Japan's Joint Staff identified a GJ-2 flight on 2025-02-26.
cases.autonomyEvidence: Military personnel performed assembly, maintenance and test flights; the record does not allocate remote and automated flight control.
cases.unresolved: Exact legal OEM, configuration relationship to Wing Loong-2, operator authority and demonstrated autonomous functions.

cases.role: Military-export product family with documented civilian mapping use; model-specific PLA service not established here.
cases.strongestEvidence: Manufacturer reports a named exporter/producer contract in August 2022; civilian customer reports continuing use and an October 2025 qualification test.
cases.autonomyEvidence: Manufacturer reports automated flight functions for a 2022 upgrade; civilian customer describes ground-station takeoff and return commands.
cases.unresolved: Configuration equivalence across records, full flight-control responsibility, PLA acceptance and ultimate export users.

cases.role: Military-oriented aircraft development; operational adoption unverified in the reviewed records.
cases.strongestEvidence: Issuer's 2025-04-02 model-specific answer reports prototype test validation; broader H1 2026 disclosures do not establish model acceptance.
cases.autonomyEvidence: No model-specific operator workflow or demonstrated allocation of autonomous decisions reviewed.
cases.unresolved: Subsequent flight-test milestones, exact contractual manufacturer, customer, acceptance and human supervision arrangements.

cases.role: Military underwater vehicle with official Navy association; OEM unassigned.
cases.strongestEvidence: HSU001 marking visually verified in a 2019 Xinhua parade photograph; organizers' aggregate in-service statement covers displayed equipment.
cases.autonomyEvidence: Officially attributed reconnaissance and surveillance functions; no observed at-sea autonomy test or human-control workflow.
cases.unresolved: Designer, manufacturer, model-specific acceptance, fleet quantity, human intervention and field performance.

cases.role: Military-oriented uncrewed surface-vessel demonstrator; separate from the dossier's unnamed 2021 export offering.
cases.strongestEvidence: CSSC reports a first public appearance in November 2024 and identifies 716 Research Institute as development lead with unnamed partners.
cases.autonomyEvidence: Uncrewed-vessel designation; no model-specific autonomous mission or human supervision arrangement demonstrated in the cited report.
cases.unresolved: Manufacturing legal entity, partner workshare, domestic acceptance, export customer and human/machine division.

cases.role: Civilian comparator: laboratory-owned research mother ship with separately documented operating and industrial partners.
cases.strongestEvidence: Reported classification milestone, January 2023 delivery, subsequent specialist trials and scientific operations.
cases.autonomyEvidence: Operator reports autonomous-navigation trials with professional crews; original project targets include open-water autonomy and remote control with crew aboard.
cases.unresolved: Repeated-mission intervention and staffing measures, tested cross-platform coordination and scope beyond recorded trials.

cases.role: Research/commercial comparator: scientific glider family with a bounded institute-to-company transfer; military destination unestablished.
cases.strongestEvidence: Published scientific observations; issuer-disclosed 2023 rights transfer for products of 2,000 metres or shallower and 2025 product sales.
cases.autonomyEvidence: Glider collects oceanographic measurements; a manufacturer-reported 2025 scientific activity identifies human deployment and recovery.
cases.unresolved: Variant mapping, original transfer schedule, contract-level end-use and intervention logs; military transfer not established.
